scenarios.name: consent flags live in the endpoint_only agreements table and cannot be forged via app SQL

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_family_contract__contracts (id, title, child_id, created_by, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('c1', 'Chores', ?, ?, 'pending', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')
